name: 이지모드
description: Flips youtube.com into a UI of your own for both music and video: search, feeds, queue and playlist management over YouTube's own player. One switch back.

scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../oc-easy-mode.zip . && cd .. && echo 'oc-easy-mode.zip'
scripts.shots: npm run build && SHOT_DIR=site npx playwright test --config=playwright.tools.ts shots
